results.title: Fifteen Years After Her Own Bronze, Ashwini Ponnappa Backs Treesa-Gayatri To Go 'Bigger' At Badminton Worlds
results.description: Ashwini Ponnappa and Jwala Gutta won India's last women's doubles medal at the Worlds in 2011. Fifteen years on, Treesa-Gayatri have matched that, reaching the semifinals, while Satwik-Chirag's bid ended in the quarterfinals. Ponnappa tells Outlook India she wants the pair to go bigger and better

results.description: Ghana’s badminton team achieved its strongest Olympic qualifying result in 64 years, securing four medals at the Badminton Grand Slam 2026 held at the Borteyman Sports Complex in Accra.
